caption: The drawing depicts a single object that appears to be a hand tool. It is composed primarily of two parts: a cylindrical handle on the left side with rough, wood-like texture lines, and a metal frame attached to it. The metal frame consists of three straight bars arranged in a triangular formation, with additional internal supports dividing the triangle into three smaller sections. The triangular frame is elevated off the surface by three downward-extending legs, each bent at the bottom to form feet that sit flat. The lines are rendered in black ink on a lightly yellowed, plain background, and there are no other colors present in the drawing. The composition is centered on the page, and the drawing is signed in the lower right corner.
title: Flat Iron Holder
